storyTitle: India's ₹11 Lakh Crore Climate Finance Challenge
tierChangeRationale: India's NDC 2022 & MoF Task Force Report verified: ₹11 lakh crore ($160B/yr) annual investment requirement to 2030. Explicitly distinguished from actual committed flows.
domainFactCheckDetails: India's Updated Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) 2022 & Ministry of Finance Climate Finance Report 2023: ₹11 lakh crore ($160-170 billion per year) represents India's estimated ANNUAL climate investment requirement through 2030 to achieve 50% non-fossil cumulative electric power capacity. Total cumulative requirement to 2030 is $2.5 trillion. 2070 Net-Zero pathway requirement estimated by CEEW at $10.1 trillion.

authoritativeSources.exactTitle: Report of the Task Force on Climate Finance & India's Updated NDC
authoritativeSources.relevantPassageOrDataCell: Annual climate investment requirement of ₹11 lakh crore to meet 2030 NDC targets.
authoritativeSources.caveats: Distinguishes annual investment requirement from actual committed/mobilized climate finance flows.
